item.title: The specialist labor supporting the energy transition
item.description: From solar installers to wind turbine technicians, meeting America's growing electricity demand requires a skilled workforce. For infrastructure investors, how those jobs are created matters.

item.title: Schroders Greencoat Infrastructure Lens H2 2026
item.description: Rising electricity demand and a renewed focus on energy security is highlighting the need for investment in domestically-sourced renewables and supporting infrastructure – but fundraising and deal activity remain subdued amid broader uncertainty, supporting attractive entry points for disciplined investors.

item.title: Our multi-asset investment views - October 2026
item.description: Resilient growth and continued earnings momentum support our positive view on equities. The main risk to our forecasts is that longer-term bond yields rise more than expected.
